defs.def: on the other side of a particular area from sb/sth and usually facing them 对面的；另一边的

ex.t: 你想成为一名高效的演讲者。

defs.def: facing the speaker or sb/sth that has been mentioned 用于名词后

ex.s: If “hard” is the opposite of “soft”, why are “hardly” and “softly” not an opposing pair?
ex.t: 如果hard是soft的反义词，为什么hardly和softly不是一对反义词？

defs.def: as different as possible from sth 相反的；迥然不同的

ex.s: But the opposite happened: She was flooded, shipping out 1,200 orders in June of 2020 alone.
ex.t: 但情况恰恰相反：她订单爆满，仅2020年6月就发出了1200份订单。

ex.s: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “it would be wise to stop cloud seeding.” In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
ex.t: 鉴于怀疑的程度，斯坦万德先生建议：“停止人工降雨是明智的。”但在实践中，怀疑产生了相反的效果。

ex.s: It clearly showed that while likability can lead to healthy adjustment, high status has just the opposite effect on us."
ex.t: 结果清楚地表明，虽然讨人喜欢可以促进健康的适应，但高地位对我们却有完全相反的效果。"

ex.s: Does Kilimanjaro   60   its reputation as a crowded mountain with lines of tourists ruining the atmosphere of peace？I found the opposite to be true.
ex.t: 乞力马扎罗山___60___它作为一座拥挤、游客排成长队破坏宁静氛围的山之名声了吗？我发现事实恰恰相反。

ex.s: As they gathered in the public square, one of them, the chicken, was seen by her neighbours going in the opposite direction.
ex.t: 当它们聚集在公共广场上时，其中一个——小鸡——被她的邻居看到朝相反的方向走去。

ex.s: Yet the exact opposite was true: the participants who made deliberate errors learned about twice as much as the people who simply copied out the correct definitions.
ex.t: 然而事实恰恰相反：那些故意犯错的参与者学到的东西大约是单纯抄写正确定义的人的两倍。

ex.s: If harmless actions are the opposite of harmful actions, why are shameless and shameful behaviors the same?
ex.t: 如果无害的行为与有害的行为相反，为什么无耻和可耻的行为却是一样的？

ex.s: Here was this challenging student who had a reputation for single-mindedness and good grades—the exact opposite of me.
ex.t: 这位极具挑战性的学生以专心和好成绩闻名——与我截然相反。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: If you add un- or in- to a word, the new word usually means the opposite.
ex.t: 如果你在词前加un-或in-，新词通常意思相反。

defs.def: on the other side of a particular area from sb/sth, and usually facing them 与 … 相对；在 … 对面

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

defs.def: acting in a film/movie or play as the partner of sb 与 … 合演；与 … 联袂演出
